description: This file defines the 'Nationality' entity class used in the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the 'ohrm_nationality' database table and includes properties for 'id' and 'name' with corresponding getter and setter methods. The class utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping.

classes.name: Nationality
classes.description: Entity class representing a nationality with properties for ID and name, and associated getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the nationality.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the nationality.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the nationality.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the nationality.
